name: Prehistoric evidence
description: Archaeological traces of ritual and belief before writing: burials, figurines, cave art, monumental sanctuaries.

name: Ancient Near East
description: Religions of Mesopotamia, Anatolia, the Levant, Elam and pre-Islamic Arabia.

name: Ancient Egypt and the Nile Valley
description: Religion of pharaonic Egypt and of Nubia/Kush.

name: Iranian religions
description: Zoroastrianism and related Iranian traditions, Manichaeism, Mandaeism, Yazidism, Yarsanism.

name: Abrahamic religions
description: Judaism, Christianity, Islam, the Bahá'í Faith and their branches and offshoots.

name: Late antique mystery, gnostic and philosophical religion
description: Mystery cults, Gnosticism, Hermeticism and Platonist religious philosophy of the Greco-Roman world.

name: Pre-Christian Europe
description: Greek, Roman, Etruscan, Celtic, Germanic, Norse, Slavic, Baltic, Finnic, Sámi and other European religions.

name: Indian religions
description: Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, Sikhism and other traditions that arose in South Asia.

name: Indigenous religions of South and Himalayan Asia
description: Tribal and Indigenous traditions of India, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and the eastern Himalaya.

name: East Asian religions
description: Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Vietnamese traditions, including Confucianism, Daoism, Shinto and folk religion.

name: Inner Asian and Arctic religions
description: Tengrism, Mongolian and Siberian shamanism, Bon, Uralic and Arctic Eurasian traditions.

name: Indigenous religions of Southeast Asia
description: Indigenous and local traditions of mainland and island Southeast Asia, including the Philippines.

name: African traditional religions
description: Indigenous religions of sub-Saharan and North Africa and their modern revivals.

name: Afro-diasporic religions
description: Religions formed by Africans and their descendants in the Americas.

name: Indigenous religions of the Americas
description: Religions of the Indigenous peoples of North, Central and South America and the Caribbean.

name: Indigenous religions of Australia and the Pacific
description: Aboriginal Australian, Torres Strait Islander, Polynesian, Melanesian and Micronesian traditions.

name: Western esoteric and metaphysical currents
description: Hermetic, Rosicrucian, Theosophical, occult, Spiritualist and New Thought traditions.

name: Contemporary Paganism
description: Modern revivals and reconstructions of pre-Christian religions, and Wicca.

name: Other new religious movements
description: Modern religions not derived from a single older family (UFO religions, Scientology, parody religions and others).

name: Humanist and rationalist traditions
description: Deism, religions of humanity, Ethical Culture, Humanism and secular congregations.
